name: Your husband
detailed_description: 《Your Husband》 is a unique desktop pet game designed to bring you endless joy and companionship. By importing 3D models, you can transform your beloved characters into virtual companions and enjoy real-time interaction. The character's gaze follows your mouse movements, with preset poses and customization options for tailored experiences. Whether relaxing or adding fun to your day, it becomes a loyal desktop companion. Add to your wishlist now and embark on a virtual journey filled with love and connection!
